SELECT favorite.goalId, favorite.categoryId, favorite.title, favorite.amount FROM (
SELECT tg.goal_id AS goalId, 1 AS categoryId, tg.title AS title, COALESCE(tc.total_cost, 0) AS amount, ub.created_date AS bookmarkedDate FROM user_bookmark ub INNER JOIN travel_goal tg ON ub.goal_id = tg.goal_id AND ub.category_id = 1 AND tg.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN travel_cost tc ON tg.goal_id = tc.goal_id AND tc.del_yn = 'N' WHERE ub.user_id = #{userId} AND ub.del_yn = 'N' AND tg.status = 'CONFIRMED'
UNION ALL
SELECT jg.goal_id AS goalId, 2 AS categoryId, jc.category_name AS title, ( COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(jgq.selected_cost) FROM job_goal_qualification jgq WHERE jgq.goal_id = jg.goal_id AND jgq.del_yn = 'N' ), 0) + COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(jgc.selected_cost) FROM job_goal_course jgc WHERE jgc.goal_id = jg.goal_id AND jgc.del_yn = 'N' ), 0) ) AS amount, ub.created_date AS bookmarkedDate FROM user_bookmark ub INNER JOIN job_goal jg ON ub.goal_id = jg.goal_id AND ub.category_id = 2 AND jg.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN job_category jc ON jg.category_id = jc.category_id AND jc.del_yn = 'N' WHERE ub.user_id = #{userId} AND ub.del_yn = 'N' AND jg.status = 'CONFIRMED'
UNION ALL
SELECT cg.goal_id AS goalId, 3 AS categoryId, CONCAT( cm.model_name, CASE WHEN cg.selected_year IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(' (', cg.selected_year, ')') ELSE '' END ) AS title, COALESCE(cm.base_price * 10000, 0) AS amount, ub.created_date AS bookmarkedDate FROM user_bookmark ub INNER JOIN car_goal cg ON ub.goal_id = cg.goal_id AND ub.category_id = 3 LEFT JOIN car_model cm ON cg.selected_model_id = cm.model_id AND cm.del_yn = 'N' WHERE ub.user_id = #{userId} AND ub.del_yn = 'N' AND cg.status = 'confirmed'
UNION ALL
SELECT rg.goal_id AS goalId, 4 AS categoryId, COALESCE(rg.title, '자취 목표') AS title, NULL AS amount, ub.created_date AS bookmarkedDate FROM user_bookmark ub INNER JOIN rent_goal rg ON ub.goal_id = rg.goal_id AND ub.category_id = 4 AND rg.del_yn = 'N' WHERE ub.user_id = #{userId} AND ub.del_yn = 'N' AND rg.status = 'CONFIRMED' ) favorite ORDER BY favorite.bookmarkedDate DESC

SELECT schedule.category AS category, schedule.title AS title, schedule.schedule_date AS scheduleDate, DATEDIFF(schedule.schedule_date, CURDATE()) AS dDay FROM (
SELECT 'TRAVEL' AS category, tg.title AS title, tg.start_date AS schedule_date FROM travel_goal tg WHERE tg.user_id = #{userId} AND tg.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND tg.del_yn = 'N' AND tg.start_date >= CURDATE()
UNION ALL
SELECT 'JOB' AS category, jq.qual_name AS title, jqs.written_exam_start_date AS schedule_date FROM job_goal jg INNER JOIN job_goal_qualification jgq ON jg.goal_id = jgq.goal_id AND jgq.del_yn = 'N' INNER JOIN job_qualification jq ON jgq.qual_id = jq.qual_id AND jq.del_yn = 'N' INNER JOIN job_qualification_schedule jqs ON jq.qual_id = jqs.qual_id WHERE jg.user_id = #{userId} AND jg.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND jg.del_yn = 'N' AND jqs.written_exam_start_date >= CURDATE() ) schedule ORDER BY schedule.schedule_date ASC LIMIT 2
